title: Point Nepean Portsea Market
summary: Stunning artisan market set among historic buildings and tea trees in Point Nepean National Park. Everything sold is made or grown by stallholders. Artisan stalls, fresh produce, food vans, live music. Roads become pedestrian walkways during the market. No dogs (service dogs exempt). Shade limited;
